reports.notes:
Completed a final walkthrough of Cells 1 and 2.
A significant number of water leaks are still present, particularly in Cell 1. Additional spray foam repairs are required, and the work is estimated to be approximately 40% complete.
Numerous leaks were observed where the hollow-core panels sits on the angle iron. One hollow-core panel in Cell 1 appears to be holding water, causing a noticeable bow in the panel.
All leaks and cracks have been documented and mapped. The final documentation will be provided to Hayden for review and repair coordination.
